standard_macros._comment: Stock FLSUN macros have no clean-nozzle or HELIX_* helpers, so the default quick buttons would run missing macros. Bed Level is FLSUN's delta calibration (BED_LEVEL_1, ends in SAVE_CONFIG). bed_mesh is left to detection: the Bed Mesh panel calibrates named profiles through it, which BED_LEVEL_2 cannot do.

leds._comment: The enclosure light is FLSUN's box_light module, not a Klipper LED object: F106 S1 / F106 S0 switch it (box_light.value follows).
